source_note: FILL IN: where these ten comments really came from (page, date copied, who copied them)

comments.body: I've been hunting through GitHub release pages for months 😩 and this just puts everything in one place. Tapped install and it picked the right APK for my phone first time 🙌
No ads. No tracking. No "create an account" nonsense. In 2026?? I had to double check I wasn't dreaming 😂
Update notifications are the killer feature for me 🔔 Got pinged about a new release before I even knew one was coming. Never going back to manual checking.
Dark mode is gorgeous 🌙 and the compare-two-apps view saved me from picking the wrong one. Only wish the trust score explained itself a bit more 🤔
An update broke my favourite app and I nearly panicked 😬 then found the rollback option. Back to the old version in 10 seconds. You've earned a fan 💯
Great idea, honestly, but a lot of listings have no screenshots 📷 and search crawled on my mobile data 🐌 Fix those and it's a 5 for me.
Synced my GitHub stars into favourites and my whole wishlist appeared instantly ✨ Would love more categories for dev tools.
Open source, free, respects privacy. I sent it to my whole class group chat and three people have already installed it 🥳
Use it daily now. It feels like a proper Play Store alternative but without the baggage ❤️ Please keep it this clean!
Was skeptical at first 🤨 then I saw the signature check and the install history. Okay, this is legit. Five stars, no notes 🔥
